## Overview

Behavioral analyses for a pretest–training–posttest study comparing math instruction with and without gesture. Sixty-four children were randomly assigned to speech-only (n = 32) or speech-and-gesture (n = 32) instruction.


Outcomes:
1. Problem solving: accuracy on equivalence problems at pretest, training, and posttest.
2. Problem encoding: errors when reproducing problems, including whether the blank and equal sign are included.
3. Strategy ratings: how children rated correct and incorrect strategies.
4. Mediation: whether encoding and strategy ratings explain the gesture effect on problem solving.
5. Problem grouping: whether gesture changes which problem features (problem type, matching addends, number of addends, blank location) children use to group problems.

Covariates: `MM` = Speeded math test time; `AveragePretest_EQ` = pretest problem solving.

Data availability: Participant data are not included in this repository.

```{r load-grouping-data}
GroupingData.Participants = unique(GroupingData$ParticipantID)
```

```{r check-participant-ids}
GroupingData.Participants
PKGData.Participants = unique(PKGData$ParticipantID)
PKGData.Participants


match(GroupingData.Participants,PKGData.Participants)
```

```{r merge-grouping-data}
TempData <- PKGData %>%
  mutate(
    # Standardize capitalization
    ParticipantID = str_to_upper(ParticipantID),

    # Add missing JAZ suffix
    ParticipantID = if_else(
      !str_ends(ParticipantID, "JAZ"),
      paste0(ParticipantID, "JAZ"),
      ParticipantID
    ),

    # Fix IDs that appear to be typos
    ParticipantID = recode(
      ParticipantID,
      "REDACTED" = "REDACTED",
      "REDACTED" = "REDACTED",
      "REDACTED" = "REDACTED"
    )
  )

GroupingData$ProblemType = "CAT"

matched_GroupingDataSet <- TempData %>%
  full_join(
    GroupingData,
    by = c("ParticipantID","TestTime","ProblemType")
  )

RemergeValues = TempData %>% 
  dplyr::select(ParticipantID, Condition, MM, AveragePretest_EQ) %>% 
  distinct()

GroupingDataset = matched_GroupingDataSet %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(Condition, MM, AveragePretest_EQ)) %>%
  full_join(RemergeValues, by = c("ParticipantID"))

GroupingDataset = GroupingDataset %>% 
  filter(ProblemType == "CAT")
```

```{r concurrent-averages}
ConcurrentAverage.DF = PKGData %>%
  group_by(ParticipantID, ProblemType, TestTime) %>%
  summarize(ConcurrentAverage = mean(Score, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = ProblemType, names_prefix = "Average", values_from = ConcurrentAverage)
```

## Encoding averages

Per-participant encoding scores by problem feature and test time, joined back onto the main dataset.


```{r encoding-averages}
EncodingAverages.DF = PKGData %>%
  filter(ProblemType == "PR") %>%
  group_by(ParticipantID, ProblemType, TestTime, ProblemFeatures) %>%
  summarize(Average = mean(Score, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(ProblemType, ProblemFeatures, TestTime), names_prefix = "Average", values_from = Average)
```

```{r join-encoding-averages}
PKGData = left_join(PKGData, EncodingAverages.DF)
```




```{r set-reference-condition}
PKGData$Condition = factor(PKGData$Condition, ordered = FALSE)
PKGData$Condition = relevel(PKGData$Condition, ref = c("Speech Only"))
```


## Problem solving (equivalence problems)

Mixed-effects logistic regressions on equivalence-problem accuracy at pretest, training, and each half of the posttest, controlling for speeded math test time and pretest problem solving, with random intercepts for participant and problem
Conditions did not differ at pretest; children in the gesture condition outperformed the speech-only condition at training and posttest. 

```{r eq-pretest-model}
EQ_Pretest_Model = PKGData %>%
  #filter(AveragePretest_EQ < 1) %>%
  filter(ProblemNumber < 5) %>%
  filter(ProblemType == "EQ") %>%
  mutate(ProblemNumber = as.factor(ProblemNumber)) %>%
  filter(TestTime == "Pretest") %>%
  glmer(Score ~ scale(MM) + Condition + (1|ProblemNumber) + (1|ParticipantID),
       data = .,family = binomial, glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa", 
                    optCtrl=list(maxfun=1e5)))
summary(EQ_Pretest_Model)
```



```{r eq-training-model}
EQ_Training_Model = PKGData %>%
  #filter(AveragePretest_EQ < 1) %>%
  filter(ProblemNumber < 5) %>%
  filter(ProblemType == "EQ") %>%
  mutate(ProblemNumber = as.factor(ProblemNumber)) %>%
  filter(TestTime == "Training") %>%
  glmer(Score ~ scale(MM) + AveragePretest_EQ + Condition + (1|ProblemNumber) + (1|ParticipantID),
       data = .,family = binomial, glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa", 
                    optCtrl=list(maxfun=1e5)))
summary(EQ_Training_Model)
```





```{r eq-posttest-first-half}
EQ_Posttest_Model.FirstFour = PKGData %>%
  #filter(AveragePretest_EQ < 1) %>%
  filter(ProblemNumber < 5) %>%
  filter(ProblemType == "EQ") %>%
  mutate(ProblemNumber = as.factor(ProblemNumber)) %>%
  filter(TestTime == "Posttest") %>%
  glmer(Score ~ scale(MM) + AveragePretest_EQ + Condition + (1|ProblemNumber) + (1|ParticipantID),
       data = .,family = binomial, glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa", 
                    optCtrl=list(maxfun=1e5)))
summary(EQ_Posttest_Model.FirstFour)
```

```{r eq-posttest-second-half}
EQ_Posttest_Model.SecondFour = PKGData %>%
  #filter(AveragePretest_EQ < 1) %>%
  filter(ProblemNumber > 4) %>%
  filter(ProblemType == "EQ") %>%
  mutate(ProblemNumber = as.factor(ProblemNumber)) %>%
  filter(TestTime == "Posttest") %>%
  glmer(Score ~ scale(MM) + AveragePretest_EQ + Condition + (1|ProblemNumber) + (1|ParticipantID),
       data = .,family = binomial, glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa", 
                    optCtrl=list(maxfun=1e5)))
summary(EQ_Posttest_Model.SecondFour)
```

### Figure: problem solving across test times

```{r eq-figure}



annotation_df1 <- data.frame(
  TestTime = c("Training","Posttest_1","Posttest_2"),
  start = c(1.7, 2.7, 3.7),
  end = c(2.3,3.3,4.3),
  y = c(1,1,1),
  label = c(paste0('p = ', round(coef(summary(EQ_Training_Model))['ConditionSpeech and Gesture', 'Pr(>|z|)'] ,3)), 
            paste0('p = ', round(coef(summary(EQ_Posttest_Model.FirstFour))['ConditionSpeech and Gesture', 'Pr(>|z|)'] ,3)), 
            paste0('p = ', round(coef(summary(EQ_Posttest_Model.SecondFour))['ConditionSpeech and Gesture', 'Pr(>|z|)'] ,3))))
annotation_df1$TestTime = factor(annotation_df1$TestTime, levels = c("Pretest", "Training", "Posttest"))






PKGData %>%
  filter(ProblemType == "EQ") %>%
  mutate(TestTime_2 = case_when(TestTime == "Pretest" ~ TestTime,
                               TestTime == "Training" ~ TestTime,
                               TestTime == "Posttest" & ProblemNumber < 5 ~ "Posttest 1",
                               TestTime == "Posttest" & ProblemNumber > 4 ~ "Posttest 2")) %>%
  group_by(ParticipantID, Condition, TestTime_2) %>%
  summarize(AverageScore = mean(Score)) %>%
  mutate(TestTime_2 = factor(TestTime_2, levels = c('Pretest', 'Training', 'Posttest 1', "Posttest 2"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=TestTime_2, y=AverageScore, color = Condition)) +
    stat_summary(geom="pointrange", position=position_dodge(.5)) +
    labs(x = "Testing Time", y = "Average Problem Solving",) + #title = "Children Instructed with Gesture Solve More Training and Posttest Problems Correctly") +
    geom_signif(
    data = annotation_df1,
    aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, annotations = label, y_position = y),
    textsize = 4, vjust = -0.2,
    manual = TRUE, inherit.aes = FALSE)+
    theme_bw(base_size = 16) + 
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,1.05)) + 
    labs(color = "Instructional Condition") + 
    scale_color_manual(values = UiowaColorsTri)

```

## Problem encoding

Encoding errors at posttest by problem feature (left vs. right blank), with a condition × feature interaction.




```{r encoding-model}
PR_Posttest_Model.Int = PKGData %>%
  #filter(AveragePretest_EQ < 1) %>%
  mutate(ProblemNumber = as.factor(ProblemNumber)) %>%
  mutate(MM = as.numeric(MM)) %>%
  filter(ProblemType == "PR") %>%
  filter(TestTime == "Posttest") %>%
  lmer(Score ~ scale(MM) + AveragePretest_PR + ProblemFeatures*Condition + (1|ParticipantID),
       data = .)
summary(PR_Posttest_Model.Int)
```


```{r encoding-emmeans}
emmeans(PR_Posttest_Model.Int, pairwise ~ Condition | ProblemFeatures)
```



The same model with the interaction terms written in the other order.

```{r encoding-model-refit}
PR_Posttest_Model.Int = PKGData %>%
  #filter(AveragePretest_EQ < 1) %>%
  mutate(ProblemNumber = as.factor(ProblemNumber)) %>%
  mutate(MM = as.numeric(MM)) %>%
  filter(ProblemType == "PR") %>%
  filter(TestTime == "Posttest") %>%
  lmer(Score ~ scale(MM) + AveragePretest_PR + Condition*ProblemFeatures + (1|ParticipantID),
       data = .)
summary(PR_Posttest_Model.Int)
```
```{r encoding-emmeans-refit}
emmeans(PR_Posttest_Model.Int, pairwise ~ Condition | ProblemFeatures)
```

## Blank inclusion

Whether children include the blank when reproducing a problem, at posttest, controlling for pretest blank inclusion.
```{r blank-model}
PR_Posttest_Model_Blank.noEQ = PKGData %>%
  filter(ProblemType == "PR") %>%
  filter(TestTime == "Posttest") %>%
  glmer(BlankPR ~ scale(MM) + AveragePretest_EQ + BlankPRAve_Pretest + Condition +  (1|ParticipantID),
       data = .,
       family = binomial, glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa", 
                    optCtrl=list(maxfun=1e5)))
summary(PR_Posttest_Model_Blank.noEQ)
```

### Models

```{r equal-sign-model}
PR_Posttest_Model_Equal.noEQ = PKGData %>%
  filter(ProblemType == "PR") %>%
  filter(TestTime == "Posttest") %>%
  glmer(EqualSignPR ~ scale(MM) + EqualSignPRAve_Pretest + AveragePretest_EQ + Condition + (1|ParticipantID),

       family = binomial, glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa", 
                    optCtrl=list(maxfun=1e5)))
summary(PR_Posttest_Model_Equal.noEQ)
```


Adding posttest problem solving as a covariate.

```{r equal-sign-model-posttest-eq}
PR_Posttest_Model_Equal.EQ = PKGData %>%
  filter(ProblemType == "PR") %>%
  filter(TestTime == "Posttest") %>%
  glmer(EqualSignPR ~ scale(MM) + EqualSignPRAve_Pretest + AveragePretest_EQ + AveragePosttest_EQ + Condition + (1|ParticipantID),
       data = .,
       family = binomial, glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa", 
                    optCtrl=list(maxfun=1e5)))
summary(PR_Posttest_Model_Equal.EQ)
```




## Strategy ratings (vignettes)

Children rated four strategies (Add All, Add to Equal, Equivalence, Grouping) on a 1–3 scale with 1 being very smart and 3 being not-so-smart. Graph scales are reversed to make the graph easier to understand with higher values on the chart indicating higher evaluation. Linear models test condition differences at posttest, controlling for pretest ratings. 




```{r vignette-eq-model}
VignetteEQ.noEQ = PKGData %>%
  filter(ProblemType == "VI" & ProblemFeatures == "EQ") %>%
  filter(TestTime == "Posttest") %>%
  lm(Score ~ scale(MM) + AveragePretest_EQ + Pretest_VI_EQ + Condition,
     data=.)
  summary(VignetteEQ.noEQ)
```



```{r vignette-ae-model}
VignetteAE.noEQ = PKGData %>%
  filter(ProblemType == "VI" & ProblemFeatures == "AE") %>%
  filter(TestTime == "Posttest") %>%
  lm(Score ~ scale(MM) + Pretest_VI_AE + AveragePretest_EQ + Condition,
     data=.)
  summary(VignetteAE.noEQ)
```




```{r vignette-aa-model}
VignetteAA.noEQ = PKGData %>%
  filter(ProblemType == "VI" & ProblemFeatures == "AA") %>%
  filter(TestTime == "Posttest") %>%
  lm(Score ~ scale(MM) + AveragePretest_EQ + Pretest_VI_AA + Condition,
     data=.)
  summary(VignetteAA.noEQ)
```



```{r vignette-gr-model}
VignetteGR.noEQ = PKGData %>%
  filter(ProblemType == "VI" & ProblemFeatures == "GR") %>%
  filter(TestTime == "Posttest") %>%
  lm(Score ~ scale(MM) + AveragePretest_EQ + Pretest_VI_GR + Condition,
     data=.)
  summary(VignetteGR.noEQ)
```

Do children rate a strategy higher when it matches the strategy they used on the pretest?

```{r pretest-strategy-match-model}
PKGData %>%
  filter(ProblemType == "VI", TestTime == "Pretest") %>%
  mutate(StrategyMatch = case_when(Strategy_Pretest == ProblemFeatures ~ 1,
                                   Strategy_Pretest == "Correct" & ProblemFeatures == "GR" ~ 1,
                                   Strategy_Pretest == "Correct" & ProblemFeatures == "EQ" ~ 1,
                                   Strategy_Pretest == "AB" & ProblemFeatures == "AA" ~ 1,
                                   .default = 0
  )) %>%
  mutate(StrategyMatch = as.factor(StrategyMatch)) %>%
  lm(Score ~ scale(MM) + StrategyMatch,
     data=.) %>% 
  summary()
```

## Pretest encoding and posttest problem solving

Tests whether the relation between pretest encoding errors and posttest problem solving differs by condition.




```{r eq-by-pretest-encoding-model}
EQ_Posttest_Model.PR = PKGData %>%
  #filter(AveragePretest_EQ < 1) %>%
  filter(ProblemType == "EQ") %>%
  filter(TestTime == "Posttest") %>%
  mutate(ProblemNumber = as.factor(ProblemNumber)) %>%
  glmer(Score ~ scale(MM) + AveragePretest_EQ + Condition*AveragePretest_PR + (1|ProblemNumber) + (1|ParticipantID),
       data = .,family = binomial, glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa", 
                    optCtrl=list(maxfun=1e5)))
summary(EQ_Posttest_Model.PR)
```

```{r eq-by-pretest-encoding-trends}
emtrends(EQ_Posttest_Model.PR, var = "AveragePretest_PR", pairwise ~ Condition)
```

*The mediation models below use 5,000 bootstrap samples and take a long time to run.*


## Mediation models

Path models (`lavaan`) testing whether condition affects posttest problem solving through each proposed mediator, controlling for pretest problem solving, `MM`, and the mediator's pretest value. Confidence intervals come from 5,000 bootstrap samples.

### Mediator: encoding (right-blank problems)

```{r med-encoding}
parallel_model_cov <- '
  # 1. Mediator regressions (Paths a + Covariate effects)
  AveragePR_RB_Posttest ~ a1*Condition + cov_m1a*AveragePretest_EQ + cov_m1b*MM + cov_m1c*AveragePR_RB_Pretest

  # 2. Outcome regression (Paths b, Direct Path cp + Covariate effects)
  Score ~ b1*AveragePR_RB_Posttest + cp*Condition + cov_ya*AveragePretest_EQ + cov_yb*MM + cov_yc*AveragePR_RB_Pretest

  # 4. Calculate Indirect and Total Effects (Formula stays the same)
  indirect    := a1 * b1
  direct := cp
  total_effect   := cp + (a1 * b1)
'




fit = PKGData %>%
  filter(TestTime == "Posttest") %>%
  filter(ProblemType == "EQ") %>%
  mutate(MM = scale(MM)) %>%
  mutate(ProblemNumber = as.factor(ProblemNumber)) %>%
  sem(parallel_model_cov, data = ., se = "bootstrap", bootstrap = 5000)

summary(fit, ci = TRUE)
```



### Mediator: blank inclusion


```{r med-blank}
PRBlank_Mediation_Model <- '
  # 1. Mediator regressions (Paths a + Covariate effects)
  BlankPRAve_Posttest ~ a1*Condition + cov_m1a*AveragePretest_EQ + cov_m1b*MM + cov_m1c*BlankPRAve_Pretest

  # 2. Outcome regression (Paths b, Direct Path cp + Covariate effects)
  Score ~ b1*BlankPRAve_Posttest + cp*Condition + cov_ya*AveragePretest_EQ + cov_yb*MM + cov_yc*BlankPRAve_Pretest

  # 4. Calculate Indirect and Total Effects (Formula stays the same)
  indirect    := a1 * b1
  direct := cp
  total_effect   := cp + (a1 * b1)
'




fit.PRBlank_Mediation_Model = PKGData %>%
  filter(TestTime == "Posttest") %>%
  filter(ProblemType == "EQ") %>%
  mutate(MM = scale(MM)) %>%
  mutate(ProblemNumber = as.factor(ProblemNumber)) %>%
  sem(PRBlank_Mediation_Model, data = ., se = "bootstrap", bootstrap = 5000)

summary(fit.PRBlank_Mediation_Model, ci = TRUE)
```


### Parallel mediators: blank inclusion + encoding

```{r med-blank-encoding}
PR_Parallel_Mediation_Model <- '
  # 1. Mediator regressions (Paths a + Covariate effects)
  BlankPRAve_Posttest ~ a1*Condition + cov_m1a*AveragePretest_EQ + cov_m1b*MM + cov_m1c*BlankPRAve_Pretest
  AveragePR_RB_Posttest ~ a2*Condition + cov_m2a*AveragePretest_EQ + cov_m2b*MM + cov_m2c*AveragePR_RB_Pretest

  # 2. Outcome regression (Paths b, Direct Path cp + Covariate effects)
  Score ~ b1*BlankPRAve_Posttest + b2*AveragePR_RB_Posttest + cp*Condition + cov_ya*AveragePretest_EQ + cov_yb*MM + cov_yc*BlankPRAve_Pretest + cov_yd*AveragePR_RB_Pretest

  # 3. Allow residual variances of the parallel mediators to correlate
  BlankPRAve_Posttest ~~ AveragePR_RB_Posttest

  # 4. Calculate Indirect, Total, and Contrast Effects
  ind_med1     := a1 * b1               # Indirect effect through BlankPRAve_Posttest
  ind_med2     := a2 * b2               # Indirect effect through AveragePR_RB_Posttest
  total_ind    := (a1 * b1) + (a2 * b2) # Sum of both indirect paths
  
  direct       := cp                    # Direct effect of Condition
  total_effect := cp + total_ind        # Total effect of Condition
  
  # Difference between the two indirect paths to see which is stronger
  contrast     := (a1 * b1) - (a2 * b2) '



fit.PR_Parallel_Mediation_Model = PKGData %>%
  filter(TestTime == "Posttest") %>%
  filter(ProblemType == "EQ") %>%
  mutate(MM = scale(MM)) %>%
  mutate(ProblemNumber = as.factor(ProblemNumber)) %>%
  sem(PR_Parallel_Mediation_Model, data = ., se = "bootstrap", bootstrap = 5000)

summary(fit.PR_Parallel_Mediation_Model, ci = TRUE)
```

```{r med-vi-eq-encoding}
  AveragePR_RB_Posttest ~ a2*Condition + cov_m2a*AveragePretest_EQ + cov_m2b*MM + cov_m2c*AveragePR_RB_Pretest

  # 2. Outcome regression (Paths b, Direct Path cp + Covariate effects)
  Score ~ b1*Posttest_VI_EQ + b2*AveragePR_RB_Posttest + cp*Condition + cov_ya*AveragePretest_EQ + cov_yb*MM + cov_yc*Pretest_VI_EQ + cov_yd*AveragePR_RB_Pretest

  # 3. Allow residual variances of the parallel mediators to correlate
  Posttest_VI_EQ ~~ AveragePR_RB_Posttest

  # 4. Calculate Indirect, Total, and Contrast Effects

  ind_med2     := a2 * b2               # Indirect effect through AveragePR_RB_Posttest

  direct       := cp                    # Direct effect of Condition

  # Difference between the two indirect paths to see which is stronger
```

### Serial mediation: Equivalence rating → encoding

```{r med-serial-vi-eq-first}
VIEQ_Serial_Mediation_Model <- '
  # 1. Mediator 1 regression (X -> M1 + Covariates)
  Posttest_VI_EQ ~ a1*Condition + cov_m1a*AveragePretest_EQ + cov_m1b*MM + cov_m1c*Pretest_VI_EQ
  
  # 2. Mediator 2 regression (X -> M2 and M1 -> M2 + Covariates)
  # NOTE: d21 represents the serial path from Mediator 1 to Mediator 2
  AveragePR_RB_Posttest ~ a2*Condition + d21*Posttest_VI_EQ + cov_m2a*AveragePretest_EQ + cov_m2b*MM + cov_m2c*AveragePR_RB_Pretest

  # 3. Outcome regression (Paths b, Direct Path cp + Covariate effects)
  Score ~ b1*Posttest_VI_EQ + b2*AveragePR_RB_Posttest + cp*Condition + cov_ya*AveragePretest_EQ + cov_yb*MM + cov_yc*Pretest_VI_EQ + cov_yd*AveragePR_RB_Pretest

  # 4. Calculate Indirect, Total, and Specific Effects
  ind_med1     := a1 * b1                     # Indirect effect 1: Condition -> M1 -> Score
  ind_med2     := a2 * b2                     # Indirect effect 2: Condition -> M2 -> Score
  ind_serial   := a1 * d21 * b2               # Serial indirect effect: Condition -> M1 -> M2 -> Score
  
  total_ind    := (a1 * b1) + (a2 * b2) + (a1 * d21 * b2) # Sum of all indirect paths
  
  direct       := cp                          # Direct effect of Condition
  total_effect := cp + total_ind              # Total effect of Condition
'

VIEQ_Serial_Mediation_Fit = PKGData %>%
  filter(TestTime == "Posttest") %>%
  filter(ProblemType == "EQ") %>%
  mutate(MM = scale(MM)) %>%
  mutate(ProblemNumber = as.factor(ProblemNumber)) %>%
  sem(VIEQ_Serial_Mediation_Model, data = ., se = "bootstrap", bootstrap = 5000)

summary(VIEQ_Serial_Mediation_Fit, ci = TRUE)
```

### Serial mediation: encoding → Equivalence rating

```{r med-serial-encoding-first}
VIEQ_Serial_Mediation_Model_Reversed <- '
  # 1. Mediator 1 regression (X -> M1 + Covariates)
  # M1 is now AveragePR_RB_Posttest
  AveragePR_RB_Posttest ~ a1*Condition + cov_m1a*AveragePretest_EQ + cov_m1b*MM + cov_m1c*AveragePR_RB_Pretest
  
  # 2. Mediator 2 regression (X -> M2 and M1 -> M2 + Covariates)
  # M2 is now Posttest_VI_EQ. d21 represents the serial path from M1 to M2.
  Posttest_VI_EQ ~ a2*Condition + d21*AveragePR_RB_Posttest + cov_m2a*AveragePretest_EQ + cov_m2b*MM + cov_m2c*Pretest_VI_EQ

  # 3. Outcome regression (Paths b, Direct Path cp + Covariate effects)
  Score ~ b1*AveragePR_RB_Posttest + b2*Posttest_VI_EQ + cp*Condition + cov_ya*AveragePretest_EQ + cov_yb*MM + cov_yc*AveragePR_RB_Pretest + cov_yd*Pretest_VI_EQ

  # 4. Calculate Indirect, Total, and Specific Effects
  ind_med1     := a1 * b1                     # Indirect effect 1: Condition -> M1 (PR_RB) -> Score
  ind_med2     := a2 * b2                     # Indirect effect 2: Condition -> M2 (VI_EQ) -> Score
  ind_serial   := a1 * d21 * b2               # Serial indirect effect: Condition -> M1 -> M2 -> Score
  
  total_ind    := (a1 * b1) + (a2 * b2) + (a1 * d21 * b2) # Sum of all indirect paths
  
  direct       := cp                          # Direct effect of Condition
  total_effect := cp + total_ind              # Total effect of Condition
'

VIEQ_Serial_Mediation_Fit_Reversed = PKGData %>%
  filter(TestTime == "Posttest") %>%
  filter(ProblemType == "EQ") %>%
  mutate(MM = scale(MM)) %>%
  mutate(ProblemNumber = as.factor(ProblemNumber)) %>%
  sem(VIEQ_Serial_Mediation_Model_Reversed, data = ., se = "bootstrap", bootstrap = 5000)

summary(VIEQ_Serial_Mediation_Fit_Reversed, ci = TRUE)
```


### Three parallel mediators: Equivalence rating, encoding, Add to Equal rating
```{r med-3-vi-eq-encoding-vi-ae}
Mediators3_Parallel_Mediation_Model <- '
  # 1. Mediator regressions (Paths a + Covariate effects)
  Posttest_VI_EQ        ~ a1*Condition + cov_m1a*AveragePretest_EQ + cov_m1b*MM + cov_m1c*Pretest_VI_EQ
  AveragePR_RB_Posttest ~ a2*Condition + cov_m2a*AveragePretest_EQ + cov_m2b*MM + cov_m2c*AveragePR_RB_Pretest
  Posttest_VI_AE        ~ a3*Condition + cov_m3a*AveragePretest_EQ + cov_m3b*MM + cov_m3c*Pretest_VI_AE

  # 2. Outcome regression (Paths b, Direct Path cp + Covariate effects)
  Score ~ b1*Posttest_VI_EQ + b2*AveragePR_RB_Posttest + b3*Posttest_VI_AE + 
          cp*Condition + 
          cov_ya*AveragePretest_EQ + cov_yb*MM + cov_yc*Pretest_VI_EQ + cov_yd*AveragePR_RB_Pretest + cov_ye*Pretest_VI_AE

  # 3. Allow residual variances of all parallel mediators to cross-correlate
  Posttest_VI_EQ        ~~ AveragePR_RB_Posttest
  Posttest_VI_EQ        ~~ Posttest_VI_AE
  AveragePR_RB_Posttest ~~ Posttest_VI_AE

  # 4. Calculate Indirect, Total, and Contrast Effects
  ind_med1     := a1 * b1               # Indirect effect through Posttest_VI_EQ
  ind_med2     := a2 * b2               # Indirect effect through AveragePR_RB_Posttest
  ind_med3     := a3 * b3               # Indirect effect through Posttest_VI_AE
  
  total_ind    := (a1 * b1) + (a2 * b2) + (a3 * b3) # Sum of all three indirect paths
  
  direct       := cp                    # Direct effect of Condition
  total_effect := cp + total_ind        # Total effect of Condition
  
  # Pairwise Contrasts to compare the mediation mechanisms
  contrast_EQ_vs_RB := (a1 * b1) - (a2 * b2) # Posttest_VI_EQ vs AveragePR_RB_Posttest
  contrast_EQ_vs_AE := (a1 * b1) - (a3 * b3) # Posttest_VI_EQ vs Posttest_VI_AE
  contrast_RB_vs_AE := (a2 * b2) - (a3 * b3) # AveragePR_RB_Posttest vs Posttest_VI_AE
'

Mediators3_Parallel_Mediation = PKGData %>%
  filter(TestTime == "Posttest") %>%
  filter(ProblemType == "EQ") %>%
  mutate(MM = scale(MM)) %>%
  mutate(ProblemNumber = as.factor(ProblemNumber)) %>%
  sem(Mediators3_Parallel_Mediation_Model, data = ., se = "bootstrap", bootstrap = 5000)

summary(Mediators3_Parallel_Mediation, ci = TRUE)


```

### Three parallel mediators: Equivalence rating, encoding, blank inclusion

```{r med-3-vi-eq-encoding-blank}
Mediators3_Parallel_Mediation_Model.PRBlankVIEQ <- '
  # 1. Mediator regressions (Paths a + Covariate effects)
  Posttest_VI_EQ        ~ a1*Condition + cov_m1a*AveragePretest_EQ + cov_m1b*MM + cov_m1c*Pretest_VI_EQ
  AveragePR_RB_Posttest ~ a2*Condition + cov_m2a*AveragePretest_EQ + cov_m2b*MM + cov_m2c*AveragePR_RB_Pretest
  BlankPRAve_Posttest        ~ a3*Condition + cov_m3a*AveragePretest_EQ + cov_m3b*MM + cov_m3c*BlankPRAve_Pretest

  # 2. Outcome regression (Paths b, Direct Path cp + Covariate effects)
  Score ~ b1*Posttest_VI_EQ + b2*AveragePR_RB_Posttest + b3*BlankPRAve_Posttest + 
          cp*Condition + 
          cov_ya*AveragePretest_EQ + cov_yb*MM + cov_yc*Pretest_VI_EQ + cov_yd*AveragePR_RB_Pretest + cov_ye*BlankPRAve_Pretest

  # 3. Allow residual variances of all parallel mediators to cross-correlate
  Posttest_VI_EQ        ~~ AveragePR_RB_Posttest
  Posttest_VI_EQ        ~~ BlankPRAve_Posttest
  AveragePR_RB_Posttest ~~ BlankPRAve_Posttest

  # 4. Calculate Indirect, Total, and Contrast Effects
  ind_med1     := a1 * b1               # Indirect effect through Posttest_VI_EQ
  ind_med2     := a2 * b2               # Indirect effect through AveragePR_RB_Posttest
  ind_med3     := a3 * b3               # Indirect effect through BlankPRAve_Posttest
  
  total_ind    := (a1 * b1) + (a2 * b2) + (a3 * b3) # Sum of all three indirect paths
  
  direct       := cp                    # Direct effect of Condition
  total_effect := cp + total_ind        # Total effect of Condition
  
  # Pairwise Contrasts to compare the mediation mechanisms
  contrast_EQ_vs_RB := (a1 * b1) - (a2 * b2) # Posttest_VI_EQ vs AveragePR_RB_Posttest
  contrast_EQ_vs_Bl := (a1 * b1) - (a3 * b3) # Posttest_VI_EQ vs Posttest_VI_AE
  contrast_RB_vs_Bl := (a2 * b2) - (a3 * b3) # AveragePR_RB_Posttest vs Posttest_VI_AE
'

fix.Mediators3_Parallel_Mediation = PKGData %>%
  filter(TestTime == "Posttest") %>%
  filter(ProblemType == "EQ") %>%
  mutate(MM = scale(MM)) %>%
  mutate(ProblemNumber = as.factor(ProblemNumber)) %>%
  sem(Mediators3_Parallel_Mediation_Model.PRBlankVIEQ, data = ., se = "bootstrap", bootstrap = 5000)

summary(fix.Mediators3_Parallel_Mediation, ci = TRUE)


```

### Four parallel mediators

```{r med-4}
Mediators4_Parallel_Mediation_Model <- '
  # 1. Mediator regressions (Paths a + Covariate effects)
  Posttest_VI_EQ        ~ a1*Condition + cov_m1a*AveragePretest_EQ + cov_m1b*MM + cov_m1c*Pretest_VI_EQ
  AveragePR_RB_Posttest ~ a2*Condition + cov_m2a*AveragePretest_EQ + cov_m2b*MM + cov_m2c*AveragePR_RB_Pretest
  Posttest_VI_AE        ~ a3*Condition + cov_m3a*AveragePretest_EQ + cov_m3b*MM + cov_m3c*Pretest_VI_AE
  BlankPRAve_Posttest   ~ a4*Condition + cov_m4a*AveragePretest_EQ + cov_m4b*MM + cov_m4c*BlankPRAve_Pretest

  # 2. Outcome regression (Paths b, Direct Path cp + Covariate effects)
  Score ~ b1*Posttest_VI_EQ + b2*AveragePR_RB_Posttest + b3*Posttest_VI_AE + b4*BlankPRAve_Posttest + 
          cp*Condition + 
          cov_ya*AveragePretest_EQ + cov_yb*MM + cov_yc*Pretest_VI_EQ + cov_yd*AveragePR_RB_Pretest + cov_ye*Pretest_VI_AE + cov_yf*BlankPRAve_Pretest

  # 3. Allow residual variances of all 4 parallel mediators to cross-correlate (6 unique pairs)
  Posttest_VI_EQ        ~~ AveragePR_RB_Posttest
  Posttest_VI_EQ        ~~ Posttest_VI_AE
  Posttest_VI_EQ        ~~ BlankPRAve_Posttest
  AveragePR_RB_Posttest ~~ Posttest_VI_AE
  AveragePR_RB_Posttest ~~ BlankPRAve_Posttest
  Posttest_VI_AE        ~~ BlankPRAve_Posttest

  # 4. Calculate Indirect, Total, and Contrast Effects
  ind_med1     := a1 * b1               # Indirect effect through Posttest_VI_EQ
  ind_med2     := a2 * b2               # Indirect effect through AveragePR_RB_Posttest
  ind_med3     := a3 * b3               # Indirect effect through Posttest_VI_AE
  ind_med4     := a4 * b4               # Indirect effect through BlankPRAve_Posttest
  
  total_ind    := (a1 * b1) + (a2 * b2) + (a3 * b3) + (a4 * b4) # Sum of all four indirect paths
  
  direct       := cp                    # Direct effect of Condition
  total_effect := cp + total_ind        # Total effect of Condition
  
  # Pairwise Contrasts to compare the mediation mechanisms
  contrast_EQ_vs_RB   := (a1 * b1) - (a2 * b2)
  contrast_EQ_vs_AE   := (a1 * b1) - (a3 * b3)
  contrast_EQ_vs_Blank := (a1 * b1) - (a4 * b4)
  contrast_RB_vs_AE   := (a2 * b2) - (a3 * b3)
  contrast_RB_vs_Blank := (a2 * b2) - (a4 * b4)
  contrast_AE_vs_Blank := (a3 * b3) - (a4 * b4)
'




Mediators4_Parallel_Mediation = PKGData %>%
  filter(TestTime == "Posttest") %>%
  filter(ProblemType == "EQ") %>%
  mutate(MM = scale(MM)) %>%
  mutate(ProblemNumber = as.factor(ProblemNumber)) %>%
  sem(Mediators4_Parallel_Mediation_Model, data = ., se = "bootstrap", bootstrap = 5000)

summary(Mediators4_Parallel_Mediation, ci = TRUE)

```





### Mediator: encoding (unstandardized `MM`)

The encoding model from above, without standardizing `MM`.

```{r med-encoding-unscaled}
parallel_model_cov <- '
  # 1. Mediator regressions (Paths a + Covariate effects)
  AveragePR_RB_Posttest ~ a1*Condition + cov_m1a*AveragePretest_EQ + cov_m1b*MM + cov_m1c*AveragePR_RB_Pretest

  # 2. Outcome regression (Paths b, Direct Path cp + Covariate effects)
  Score ~ b1*AveragePR_RB_Posttest + cp*Condition + cov_ya*AveragePretest_EQ + cov_yb*MM + cov_yc*AveragePR_RB_Pretest

  # 4. Calculate Indirect and Total Effects (Formula stays the same)
  indirect    := a1 * b1
  direct := cp
  total_effect   := cp + (a1 * b1)
'




fit = PKGData %>%
  filter(TestTime == "Posttest") %>%
  filter(ProblemType == "EQ") %>%
  mutate(ProblemNumber = as.factor(ProblemNumber)) %>%
  sem(parallel_model_cov, data = ., se = "bootstrap", bootstrap = 5000)

summary(fit, ci = TRUE)
```






















### Mediator: change in encoding (posttest − pretest)

```{r med-encoding-change}
parallel_model_cov <- '
  # 1. Mediator regressions (Paths a + Covariate effects)
  AveragePR_RBChange ~ a1*Condition + cov_m1a*AveragePretest_EQ + cov_m1b*MM + cov_m1c*AveragePR_RB_Pretest

  # 2. Outcome regression (Paths b, Direct Path cp + Covariate effects)
  Score ~ b1*AveragePR_RBChange + cp*Condition + cov_ya*AveragePretest_EQ + cov_yb*MM + cov_yc*AveragePR_RB_Pretest

  # 4. Calculate Indirect and Total Effects (Formula stays the same)
  indirect    := a1 * b1
  direct := cp
  total_effect   := cp + (a1 * b1)
'




fit = PKGData %>%
  filter(TestTime == "Posttest") %>%
  filter(ProblemType == "EQ") %>%
  mutate(ProblemNumber = as.factor(ProblemNumber)) %>%
  mutate(AveragePR_RBChange = AveragePR_RB_Pretest - AveragePR_RB_Posttest) %>%
  sem(parallel_model_cov, data = ., se = "bootstrap", bootstrap = 5000)

summary(fit, ci = TRUE)
```




## Problem grouping task


The analysis uses the features the problems were designed around (problem type, matching addends, number of addends, and blank location). Numbered comments inside the code mark each step.



### Setup

```{r design-setup}
# ==========================================================
# STEP 1: PACKAGES AND BASIC VARIABLE CODING
# ==========================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)
library(ggplot2)

GroupingDataset <- GroupingDataset %>%
  mutate(
    ParticipantID = factor(ParticipantID),

    Condition = factor(
      Condition,
      levels = c(
        "Speech Only",
        "Speech and Gesture"
      )
    ),

    TestTime = factor(
      TestTime,
      levels = c(
        "Pretest",
        "Posttest"
      )
    ),

    ProblemA_DesignType = factor(
      ProblemA_DesignType,
      levels = c(
        "Traditional",
        "Equivalence"
      )
    ),

    ProblemB_DesignType = factor(
      ProblemB_DesignType,
      levels = c(
        "Traditional",
        "Equivalence"
      )
    ),

    ProblemA_BlankLocation = factor(
      ProblemA_BlankLocation,
      levels = c(
        "Left",
        "Right"
      )
    ),

    ProblemB_BlankLocation = factor(
      ProblemB_BlankLocation,
      levels = c(
        "Left",
        "Right"
      )
    ),

    GroupedTogether = as.numeric(GroupedTogether)
  )
```

### Pretest baselines by feature

```{r design-pretest-baselines}
# ==========================================================
# STEP 5: FEATURE-SPECIFIC PRETEST BASELINES
# ==========================================================

pretest_scores <- GroupingDataset %>%
  filter(
    TestTime == "Pretest"
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    ParticipantID
  ) %>%
  summarise(

    # ------------------------------------------------------
    # SAME PROBLEM TYPE
    # Traditional-Traditional or Equivalence-Equivalence
    # versus mixed problem type
    # ------------------------------------------------------

    PreTypeSame = mean(
      GroupedTogether[
        SameDesignType == 1
      ],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    PreTypeDifferent = mean(
      GroupedTogether[
        SameDesignType == 0
      ],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    PreTypeSensitivity =
      PreTypeSame -
      PreTypeDifferent,


    # ------------------------------------------------------
    # MATCHING ADDENDS
    # Same 2/3 matching-addend design condition
    # versus different condition
    # ------------------------------------------------------

    PreMatchingSame = mean(
      GroupedTogether[
        SameMatchingAddendCount == 1
      ],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    PreMatchingDifferent = mean(
      GroupedTogether[
        SameMatchingAddendCount == 0
      ],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    PreMatchingSensitivity =
      PreMatchingSame -
      PreMatchingDifferent,


    # ------------------------------------------------------
    # NUMBER OF ADDENDS
    # ------------------------------------------------------

    PreAddendSame = mean(
      GroupedTogether[
        SameAddendNumber == 1
      ],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    PreAddendDifferent = mean(
      GroupedTogether[
        SameAddendNumber == 0
      ],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    PreAddendSensitivity =
      PreAddendSame -
      PreAddendDifferent,


    # ------------------------------------------------------
    # BLANK LOCATION
    # ------------------------------------------------------

    PreBlankSame = mean(
      GroupedTogether[
        SameBlankLocation == 1
      ],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    PreBlankDifferent = mean(
      GroupedTogether[
        SameBlankLocation == 0
      ],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    PreBlankSensitivity =
      PreBlankSame -
      PreBlankDifferent,

    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\n===== PRETEST TYPE SENSITIVITY =====\n")
print(
  summary(
    pretest_scores$PreTypeSensitivity
  )
)


cat("\n===== PRETEST MATCHING-ADDEND SENSITIVITY =====\n")
print(
  summary(
    pretest_scores$PreMatchingSensitivity
  )
)


cat("\n===== PRETEST ADDEND-NUMBER SENSITIVITY =====\n")
print(
  summary(
    pretest_scores$PreAddendSensitivity
  )
)


cat("\n===== PRETEST BLANK-LOCATION SENSITIVITY =====\n")
print(
  summary(
    pretest_scores$PreBlankSensitivity
  )
)
```

### Models by design feature

```{r design-model-type}
model_type <- glmer(
  GroupedTogether ~
    PreType_z + AveragePretest_EQ + Condition * SameDesignType +
     
    (1 | ParticipantID) +
    (1 | PairID),

  data = posttest,

  family = binomial(link = "logit"),

  control = glmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(
      maxfun = 200000
    )
  )
)

summary(model_type)

isSingular(model_type)
```


```{r design-model-matching}
model_matching <- glmer(
  GroupedTogether ~
   PreMatching_z + AveragePretest_EQ + Condition * SameMatchingAddendCount +
    
    (1 | ParticipantID) +
    (1 | PairID),

  data = posttest,

  family = binomial(link = "logit"),

  control = glmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(
      maxfun = 200000
    )
  )
)
summary(model_matching)

isSingular(model_matching)
```

```{r design-participant-matching}

    ),
```

#### Participant-level feature sensitivity

```{r design-participant-features}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

feature_long <- GroupingDataset %>%
  dplyr::select(
    ParticipantID,
    Condition,
    TestTime,
    GroupedTogether,
    SameDesignType,
    SameMatchingAddendCount,
    SameAddendNumber,
    SameBlankLocation
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      SameDesignType,
      SameMatchingAddendCount,
      SameAddendNumber,
      SameBlankLocation
    ),
    names_to = "Feature",
    values_to = "SameFeature"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Feature = recode(
      Feature,
      SameDesignType = "Problem Type",
      SameMatchingAddendCount = "Matching Addends",
      SameAddendNumber = "Number of Addends",
      SameBlankLocation = "Blank Location"
    ),

    SameFeature = factor(
      SameFeature,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("Different", "Same")
    )
  )


feature_summary <- feature_long %>%
  group_by(
    Condition,
    TestTime,
    Feature,
    SameFeature
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    GroupingRate = mean(
      GroupedTogether,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(
  feature_summary %>%
    filter(TestTime == "Posttest"),
  aes(
    x = SameFeature,
    y = GroupingRate,
    color = Condition,
    group = Condition
  )
) +
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 3
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Feature,
    nrow = 1
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, .20),
    labels = scales::percent_format(
      accuracy = 1
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Relationship Between Problems",
    y = "Proportion Grouped Together",
    color = "Instruction Condition"
  ) +
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 13
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    )
  )
```

```{r design-participant-feature-change}
participant_feature <- feature_long %>%
  group_by(
    ParticipantID,
    Condition,
    TestTime,
    Feature,
    SameFeature
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    GroupingRate = mean(
      GroupedTogether,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = SameFeature,
    values_from = GroupingRate
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    FeatureSensitivity =
      Same - Different
  )


feature_change_summary <- participant_feature %>%
  group_by(
    Condition,
    TestTime,
    Feature
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    MeanSensitivity = mean(
      FeatureSensitivity,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    SE = sd(
      FeatureSensitivity,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) /
      sqrt(
        sum(
          !is.na(
            FeatureSensitivity
          )
        )
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


ggplot(
  feature_change_summary,
  aes(
    x = TestTime,
    y = MeanSensitivity,
    color = Condition,
    group = Condition
  )
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray50"
  ) +
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 3.2
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = MeanSensitivity - 1.96 * SE,
      ymax = MeanSensitivity + 1.96 * SE
    ),
    width = .08
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Feature,
    nrow = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Test Time",
    y = "Feature-Based Grouping Sensitivity",
    color = "Instruction Condition"
  ) +
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 13
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    )
  )


```




```{r design-participant-feature-change-2}
matching_change <- participant_feature %>%
  filter(
    Feature == "Matching Addends"
  )

matching_change_summary <- matching_change %>%
  group_by(
    Condition,
    TestTime
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    MeanSensitivity = mean(
      FeatureSensitivity,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    SE = sd(
      FeatureSensitivity,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) /
      sqrt(
        sum(
          !is.na(
            FeatureSensitivity
          )
        )
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(
  matching_change_summary,
  aes(
    x = TestTime,
    y = MeanSensitivity,
    color = Condition,
    group = Condition
  )
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray50"
  ) +
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 4
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = MeanSensitivity - 1.96 * SE,
      ymax = MeanSensitivity + 1.96 * SE
    ),
    width = .08,
    linewidth = .8
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Test Time",
    y = "Matching Addends Grouping Sensitivity",
    color = "Instruction Condition"
  ) +
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 14
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top"
  )
```



```{r design-participant-feature-change-3}
ggplot(
  matching_change,
  aes(
    x = TestTime,
    y = FeatureSensitivity,
    group = ParticipantID,
    color = Condition
  )
) +
  geom_line(
    alpha = .25
  ) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = .45,
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Condition
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Test Time",
    y = "Matching Addends Grouping Sensitivity"
  ) +
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 13
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```
